title: Record of Proceeding in Consumer Mediation Cell

content.scenario: A consumer approaches a consumer mediation cell to resolve a dispute with a company. The mediation cell maintains a record of the proceeding, including the list of empanelled mediators, cases handled, and other relevant information.
content.outcome: The consumer mediation cell is required to maintain a record of proceeding as per Section 74(4) of the Consumer Protection Act, 2019. This record will include a list of empanelled mediators, a list of cases handled by the cell, and any other information specified by regulations.

user_queries: What information must a consumer mediation cell maintain as per the Consumer Protection Act?
What is the purpose of maintaining a record of proceeding in a consumer mediation cell?
Can a consumer access the record of proceeding in a consumer mediation cell?
